verdict.rationale: Notte is an LLM-powered cloud browser and agent platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no no-training guarantee. The vault claim that credentials are never exposed to LLMs and the pricing-page 'bring your own keys' row are adjacent features and do not show that user data is excluded from model training.
